content:
alex: Quick sync — audit team pushed SOC2 fieldwork earlier. We need a small matrix: who owns staging KMS/HSM evidence + smoke validation by EOD Thu. I can take evidence collection for prod KMS, need staging owner. Link to checklist: https://redwood.internal/soc2-checklist

maria: I can own staging validation for keystore + attestation steps. Will run smoke tests tomorrow morning. Can someone confirm access to staging HSM slot?

devon: I own the keystore integration code. For staging HSM access, @jamie do you have the test key provisioned? Also FYI I opened CR #4523 for auditlog retention fix.

jamie: ops-deploy-bot: deploy 1715001400 to staging succeeded :rocket:

jamie: @devon yes test key is provisioned, policy attached to service-account 'keystore-runner'. I'll add you.

sec-audit-bot: Reminder: audit evidence window opens 2024-06-01 — submit preflight by 2024-05-28 :calendar: 

alex: Thanks. @maria can you paste the smoke command and expected output once you run it? we'll attach to evidence pack.

maria: Sure. Smoke command:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://stg-keystore.redwood/api/v1/keys/test/verify | jq .status
# expected: "ok"
```

maria: If it returns ok, I'll upload screenshot to the audit ticket. If it fails, I'll ping here with logs.

devon: note on CR #4523 — retention default was 7d, changed to 90d per audit. Deployment patch ready.

alex: OK — owner map for evidence: prod-kms: alex; staging-keystore-validation: maria; code retention change: devon. I'll update the SOC2 cookbook and ping compliance.

jamie: small ask — can someone confirm who has permission to download HSM attestation report? I think it's sec-leads + infra-admins.

maria: confirmed sec-leads + infra-admins. @alex please cc security when you upload.

alex: will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
